items.name: BOMBARDIRO CROCODILO
items.description:
Br41nR0t
This collection presents a series of original vector-based digital characters illustrated in Adobe Illustrator, defined by sharp geometric forms and a restrained, contemporary graphic language. Each work balances surreal character design with precision and clarity, emphasizing form, rhythm, and composition.

The titles draw from “Italian brainrot”—a phonetic, rhythmic approach to naming that prioritizes sound, repetition, and cadence over literal meaning. These names function as a compositional element, reinforcing the playful absurdity of the characters while establishing a cohesive internal language across the collection.

Together, the works explore abstraction, modern mythmaking, and internet-era visual culture, positioning playful nonsense as a deliberate artistic tool within a refined digital art framework.

-Franky Aguilar

Opening November 8th, 7pm.
